crossRefs.note: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in…
The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house, the bronze of all these vessels…
He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases;
The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house, and the bases and the bronze sea that were in…
They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had…

parallels.note: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

translations.web: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.
translations.bsb: In addition, he made ten movable stands of bronze, each four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.
translations.kjv: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
translations.asv: And he made the ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
